He developed his own and recognizable musical language with the elements of neoclassicism.  Bjelinski composed six operas, three ballets, 15 symphonies, 2 cello concertos, a cantata, piano music, songs, chamber music, and concertos for piano, violin, viola, bassoon, flute, and piano duo.  He also composed music for the Croatian football movie "Plavi 9".
